qa.question: Should Concord unit capacity change from 95.0 MW to 95.4 MW?
qa.finding: The EIA monthly inventory for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx), Operating sheet, plant 7159, generators 1 to 4, shows a nameplate of 95.4 MW each. GEM shows 95.0 MW for each unit.
qa.recommendation: Leave as is, since the difference is rounding. Change to 95.4 only if you want to match EIA exactly.
qa.note: The air permit for the station (https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1282221) says four turbines give 312 MW in total, a lower operating figure. I did not use it.
